## ApiKeyRateLimit

Creation-time convenience for API-key- and usage-pool-scoped limits. The  server expands every populated dimension into the same independently  manageable policy rows exposed by RateLimitService. Models are public ids and  share one bucket; empty means every model on the connection. Omitting  connection_id creates a global request-level limit; global limits cannot  specify models. The historical name is retained for wire compatibility.
